_about: Shared by tests/test_rule_cases.py (Python rules) and tests/test_offline_rules.js (browser rules), so the two cannot drift. expect: 'safe' = verdict safe; 'flagged' = suspicious or scam; 'scam' = scam. Do not copy messages from eval/heldout.jsonl here.
